explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX, but i don't understand how to implement this in php.

a:

what you have to do is to store the number of items in your database and return all possible matches based on that.
for example if you have to do this:

get the number of product
get the match (products that have the same number of items, they're all duplicates)
store it in $_session
after that you do something like:
if (isset($_session["duplicate"])) {
    //do something
}

if you had to use some language you didn't know, you could have created your own little database and stored the number of your products in there.
